text:
Maria: FYI SUP-4892 — customer (third-party app on Cloudflare Workers -> NLB -> our API) sees midstream silence after ~40-50s, client reconnects, and gets duplicate/partial outputs. They reported a billing spike from repeated reconnects. Repro attached.

Alex: What proxy chain exactly? Cloudflare Worker in front of NLB? Any ALB/NGINX between worker and origin?

Maria: Worker -> Cloudflare edge -> NLB -> internal ALB -> origin pods. Customer says it only happens when edge-to-origin path goes through the Worker (no problem with direct curl to origin).

June: Can you paste the full request headers + the truncated response sample? Also which client (browser, mobile, sdk)?

Maria: Client is a mobile webview (Android). Header sample + truncated payload below.

Maria: ```
> GET /v1/stream?model=fast HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> User-Agent: RedwoodMobile/1.2

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< connection: keep-alive

< 1a\r\ndata: {"token":"hello"}\r\n\r\n
< 20\r\ndata: {"token":"this is mid payload"}\r\n\r\n
< 0\r\n\r\n

// client sees no more events, then reconnects and requests remainder -> duplicate billing
```

Alex: That 0 chunk followed by close looks like origin half-closed connection then edge reusing connection or closing unexpectedly. Any TCP FINs/logs?

Luis: From infra: Cloudflare has aggressive HTTP/2->HTTP/1 connection reuse and an idle probe ~30s. NLB default idle timeout is 350s but ALB can be 60s. If an intermediate closes the socket (FIN) while Worker still expects stream, edge may terminate without signaling SSE end properly.

Priya: Could also be Cloudflare buffering when they translate HTTP/2 streams to HTTP/1 upstreams; that can coalesce chunks and then drop after idle.

Maria: Customer captured a tcpdump of the edge -> origin window. I pasted the trace (redacted). It's showing FIN from ALB at ~46s, then Cloudflare reopens the HTTP/2 stream and the client only sees a half payload.

Alex: Quick repro I used locally: `curl -N -v` to stream then `sleep 45` on origin before sending remaining chunks. With an intermediate HTTP/2 multiplexor (simulating Cloudflare) the client saw truncated stream.

Alex: Repro snippet: ```bash
# server: send first chunks, sleep, then send tail
python -m http.server --bind 0.0.0.0 8000  # pseudo example, use custom SSE server
# client
curl -N -v http://localhost:8000/stream
```

Luis: Immediate workaround for customer: align idle timeouts across the chain. Make ALB idle_timeout > Cloudflare edge idle (or set Cloudflare Origin Keepalive to higher value in dashboard), and enable `disable_http2` on the Worker route as a test. If HTTP/2->HTTP/1 translation is the culprit, forcing HTTP/1 keepalive prevents midstream half-close.

June: We need a clear customer-facing mitigation and an internal action. Maria — can you propose a precise set of steps we gave them and verify results?

Maria: Sent steps: 1) Set ALB idle timeout to 300s, 2) In Cloudflare dashboard set Origin Keepalive to 240s, 3) Worker: set fetch options to not reuse pool (temp test) / disable HTTP/2 to origin. Customer tried ALB change -> saw immediate reduction in truncation.

SRE-bot: RD deploy 2026-03-15T22:12:03 - canary rollout to runtime v1.9.2 - no anomalies detected.

Alex: Follow-up: engineering will add a guard in runtime to detect upstream FIN and emit an explicit SSE
"event: upstream_close"
"data: reason"

so clients don't treat silence as a network stall and re-request the same token (to avoid billing duplicates). Logged RD-7621.

Luis: Also adding an ops doc for us and for customers: ensure proxies and LB idle timeouts are >= expected max idle between tokens. Default recommendation: keepalive >= 5x token interval or 300s.

Priya: Noted for docs: add a troubleshooting checklist (Cloudflare Worker -> NLB/ALB -> origin) with curl repro, tcpdump hints, and the worker config flags to try.

June: Closing loop: Maria please update SUP-4892 with the workaround instructions and mark as mitigated after 24h of no truncations. If customer wants, we can schedule a session to change their CF settings.

Maria: Will do. Customer confirmed truncations stopped after ALB idle bump. Leaving ticket open for engineering fix (RD-7621). :thumbsup:
